description: This PHP unit test file tests the ClaimDao class related to expense types within the Claim module of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It performs tests for retrieving, deleting, and checking usage of expense types, utilizing fixtures and utility classes.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTypeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ClaimDao expense type functionalities within the Claim module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating ClaimDao and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetExpenseTypeList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of expense types with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetExpenseTypeById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific expense type by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteExpenseType
methods.description: Tests deleting expense types by their IDs.

methods.name: testIsExpenseTypeUsed
methods.description: Tests checking if an expense type is used.
